speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim
text: asked the Minister for National Development (a) what is the Government's estimated budget for the Estate Upgrading Programme (EUP) for private estates for the next three years; and (b) what is the schedule for calling for EUP nominations each year.

speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
text: Is the Minister of State able to tell us or project how much budget would be available in the coming years, which was in my Parliamentary Question (PQ), the next three years?

speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
text: The second supplementary question is: do I take it that there is no fixed schedule every year to call for EUP and, therefore, it just depends on when the Ministry feels it has the resources to do so?

speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
text: The third question is: I understand from prior correspondence with the Ministry that the calling of the EUP projects will be through the Citizens' Consultative Committee (CCC).

speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
text: Could I ask whether the Ministry is also able to let the Member of Parliament of the area know that EUP projects are being called, so that we can try to work with the CCC in some way?

speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
text: Once the project is ready for announcement and we are working with the CCC and it is quite clear that the project has been finalised, we can actually notify the current Member of the ward as well.

speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim
text: My request for MND to inform the Member is at the start when you are calling for projects.

speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim
text: I do appreciate the Minister of State's confirmation that when the project has been more or less fleshed out by the CCC, the Ministry will inform us, but I am asking about the point of calling for projects, because I think we also have feedback that we can share with the Ministry as well.

speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim
text: Could the Minister of State confirm that the Ministry would also let the Member of Parliament know when the Ministry is calling for projects when the resources are available?

speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim
text: The second question is, in the recent answer, I think to Member Chong Kee Hiong, in March this year, it was mentioned that the Ministry is aware that there are at least 20 estates that are more than 30 years old that have not benefited from the EUP.

speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim
text: I believe, some of these estates are within Aljunied Group Representation Constituency (GRC), some areas in Hwan estate, Hillside, Kovan and so on.

speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim
text: Would the Ministry put this on their agenda and not forget the EUP and see whether there are resources available to allocate to it?

speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
text: So, we try to coordinate all these together.

speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
text: It is not a hard-and-fast rule that just because an estate is of a certain age, EUP will have to be done.
